scope: Ordinary native driver replacement role priority; not full crew-controller parity
reference_context: Existing HBQ crew-retention source review identifies preserving operational crew roles; its forced moveIn actions are not copied. Current CBE handover uses observed native Eject/vacancy/MoveToDriver phases.
finding: CBE preferred eligible cargo but otherwise selected the first eligible fullCrew row, giving no explicit preference to retaining the primary gunner when another replacement existed.
implementation: New attempts choose eligible cargo, then actual commander, then other eligible crew excluding actual primary gunner; primary gunner remains available only when no alternative exists. Admitted attempts retain original candidate/deadline, preventing reprioritization churn.
bounds: Existing at-most20 crew rows; two bounded filters only when no cargo, no new discovery, actor action or scheduler.
preserved: Observed driver vacancy before native seat switch
Completion requires actual candidate driver occupancy
Original25s deadline and no action replay on migration
remaining: Physical driver handover and restored movement
